name: wirepane
description: The debugging proxy Claude can read, inside Claude Code on macOS: HTTPS, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets and server-sent events from the browser, iOS and Android; one-press device setup; rules and mock servers; a doctor that fixes what is in the way; 16 tools and 3 skills for Claude.

port.title: Proxy port
port.description: The port the proxy listens on.

listen.title: Proxy reachable from
listen.description: local: this Mac only (browser, simulators, Android emulator). lan: also phones on the same network.

noDecrypt.title: Hosts never decrypted
noDecrypt.description: Comma-separated hosts tunnelled untouched (pinned services); *.example.com covers subdomains. Hosts that refuse the certificate twice are passed through on their own.

maxFlows.title: Requests to keep
maxFlows.description: How many of the latest requests the list keeps.

insecureHosts.title: Hosts with unchecked certificates
insecureHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts whose own certificate is not checked (dev servers with self-signed ones); *.example.com covers subdomains.

upstreamProxy.title: Upstream proxy (office, VPN)
upstreamProxy.description: An office's or a VPN's proxy every connection to a server goes through: http://[user:password@]host:port (Basic or Windows NTLM sign-in; DOMAIN\user as DOMAIN%5Cuser), socks5://[user:password@]host:port, or a PAC file as pac+http://[user:password@]host/proxy.pac (the credentials go to the proxies it names). Empty: servers are reached directly.

upstreamBypass.title: Hosts that skip the upstream proxy
upstreamBypass.description: Comma-separated hosts reached without the upstream proxy (this Mac's own addresses always are); *.example.com covers subdomains.
